deadline_param_supported.meaning: the Router/Core swap interface allows the user to specify a deadline for the swap transaction

tx_delay_occurred.meaning: the swap transaction was held by a validator or remained in the mempool for an extended period before execution

executed_at_unexpected_time.meaning: the user's swap transaction was executed at a time unexpected to the user (after an extended delay, beyond any user-intended time bound)

assumptions: The swap transaction is submitted by a user to the Router/Core contracts.
The delay is described as possible rather than observed; the plan formalizes the potential scenario.

unresolved.description: No concrete deadline value or delay duration is supplied; the user-specified deadline bound and the unexpected execution time are represented only by qualitative observables.

limitations: The report describes delay and execution as potential, not observed; the claim formalizes the possible scenario.
Whether slippage thresholds would still block delayed execution is not established and is not encoded.
